body:
RedeemScreen (App Link deep-link target) and RedeemDialog (drawer "Join
list") both assume an existing session — redeemInvite() 401s immediately
if the user isn't logged in, with no path to "log in, then redeem." A
logged-out user tapping an invite link currently gets bounced toward
Login with the invite token silently lost (RedeemScreen's onCancel
navigates to Overview, which itself requires login).

Fix: stash the pending token when redeem fails due to no session, then
consume it right after login succeeds — either LoginViewModel checks for
a pending token on success and routes to redeem instead of the normal
start destination, or the App Link route detects "not logged in" and
redirects to Login carrying the token along, returning to redeem after.

Found and documented while closing T-18 (A9: share/list props, invite
redemption, App Link) — see that ticket's closing note for more detail.
title: Redeem via App Link/paste fails silently when logged out
